title: Quillfeather rate cache pull request
brief:
I'm Hana Sjöberg, a developer at Quillfeather Travel Money, and I need a pull request page for pull request 619 that reviewers will read projected in our Wednesday huddle on 2026-10-28. The change caches exchange rates for 15 minutes, so quotes stop calling the rates provider every time. Sections: "Summary": provider calls drop from about 38 per second at the peak to about 2.8 a minute, since we trade 42 currency pairs and refresh each at most once every 900 seconds; the product owner accepted that a quote may use a rate up to 15 minutes old, within a tolerance of 0.3 percent. "Quote sequence": the exchange between Customer App, Quote Service, Rate Cache and Rates Provider, in order: Customer App to Quote Service "request quote GBP to EUR"; Quote Service to Rate Cache "get rate"; Rate Cache to Quote Service "hit, age 4 minutes"; Quote Service to Customer App "quote with cached rate"; then a later miss: Quote Service to Rate Cache "get rate"; Rate Cache to Rates Provider "fetch rate, entry older than 900 seconds"; Rates Provider to Rate Cache "new rate"; Rate Cache to Quote Service "new rate stored". "The change": show the code with line numbers:
1 def get_rate(pair, now):
2     entry = CACHE.get(pair)
3     if entry and now - entry.time < TTL_SECONDS:
4         return entry.rate
5     rate = provider.fetch(pair)
6     CACHE[pair] = Entry(rate, now)
7     return rate
"Risks": a list: if the provider is down, line 5 raises and quotes fail even though an old rate exists; many requests missing at the same moment all call the provider because nothing locks; and the cache never drops pairs we stop trading. Highlight the provider-down case as a warning.

edit.request: Change the cache time from 15 minutes to 10 minutes, which is 600 seconds, the tolerance to 0.2 percent, and the provider calls to about 4.2 a minute.
